hints.title: Card Cost per Row
hints.text: A row with k triangles requires 3k - 1 cards (2k leaning cards plus k - 1 horizontal cards).

hints.title: Strictly Decreasing Rows
hints.text: Each row above must have strictly fewer triangles than the row directly below it.

hints.title: 2D State Memoization
hints.text: Define dp(cards_left, prev_k) as the number of valid structures using cards_left where the next row has fewer than prev_k triangles.

hints.title: Complete Python Solution

complexity.time: O(N * sqrt(N)) memoized states and transitions
complexity.notes: Integer partition DP with strictly decreasing triangle counts.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Unmemoized tree recursion branches into redundant partitions factorially.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Memoization bounds states to N cards * (N/3) max rooms in linearithmic time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: State formula 3k - 1 and strictly decreasing layer condition.

solutions.approach: C++ 0/1 knapsack integer partition dynamic programming.
